about_the_game:
This is a game that combines turn-based development and real-time combat. Your mission is to resist the invasion of the raider army. To fight back, you must recruit soldiers, purchase skills, strengthen your army, and master the use of magic.

On this continent ravaged by war, the raider army has shattered the peace and prosperity of the past. Smoke fills the air, villages have been reduced to scorched earth, and hope seems to have vanished along with them. They surge forward like a tide, ruthlessly plundering lives and dignity, and planting deep fear in the heart of every person—but even in the darkness, there will always be someone who steps forward.

That someone is you.

The time for the final battle has come.

Thousands of troops await your command.

The fate of this continent lies in the palm of your hand.

【Development System】

Turn-based progression with multiple daily cycles. Spend Action Points to train soldiers, explore, or hunt. Use Gold to recruit troops and purchase skills from the shop.

Training soldiers grants temporary bonuses. Exploring triggers random encounters—some beneficial, others detrimental. When funds run low, hunt for gold.

Daily soldier maintenance fees are required; unpaid troops will desert.

【Shop System】

The shop offers soldier recruitment and skill purchases. Skill items refresh per turn, while soldier availability resets daily. Spend gold to instantly refresh skill items.

Skills are divided into active and passive. Active skills consume mana to instantly deal damage. Passive skills provide various buffs, such as soldier HP, attack power, skill damage, and mana regeneration speed.

【Battle System】

Real-time combat supports battlefields with thousands of soldiers. Troops fight autonomously without command. You control skills from a god's-eye view to coordinate with your soldiers and eliminate enemies. Most skills have cooldowns and consume mana, with stronger skills requiring higher mana expenditure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6400 / AMD X8 FX-8300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 2300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: This is a squad-building game set in a medieval fantasy world, blending turn-based development with real-time combat. As the commander of a small team, you will recruit soldiers, acquire skills, strengthen your army, and repel invaders. Write your own legendary story.
supported_languages: English, French, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean, German, Spanish - Spain
